newsitem.title: USA: MatriDigm unveils product to fix Year 2000 glitch.
newsitem.headline: MatriDigm unveils product to fix Year 2000 glitch.

text.p: MatriDigm Corp, a software maintenance company, on Monday said its MAP2000 product will become commercially available on February 10.

In a statement, the company said the so-called Year 2000 product, which rapidly finds, fixes and tests all date-related fields in an application, will be available directly to customers and through selected value-added retailers.

Currently, Zitel Corp and Business Records Corp are established value-added retailers for the MatriDigm service. The company said similar relationships with other large consulting and service-provider organizations were being negotiated.
The computer industry has been trying to come up with a solution to the Year 2000 problem, under which computers using a two-digit dating system can crash when the year changes to 2000.
Zitel was up 1-3/8 to 47-1/8, and Business Records was up 2-1/4 to 47-1/2 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
